comment: Commons files a human has looked at and refused, and why. The fetcher never chooses one of these again and the validator refuses a manifest containing one. This list exists because the automatic checks cannot see the picture: they read a title, a licence and a pixel count. Everything below passed all three and was still wrong.

files.title: File:RedDot Burger.jpg
files.reason: A glass of beer in frame and bacon in the burger. This catalogue is built for Egypt; neither belongs on a recipe card, and no rule reading a filename can see them.

files.title: File:Menemen.jpg
files.reason: An aerial photograph of the Turkish town of Menemen. The dish is named after the place, so its Commons category is mostly landscapes.

files.title: File:Warak enab.jpg
files.reason: A grape vine growing in a garden. Warak enab is the stuffed leaf, not the plant it came from.

files.title: File:Dorset Cereals muesli.jpg
files.reason: A heap of dry muesli. Raw ingredients rather than a bowl of anything, and branded packaging cereal at that.

files.title: File:Cheese kunafa at Agasi, Lajpat Nagar, Delhi (2025-10-04).jpg
files.reason: A pale flat pancake. Correctly named and not recognisable as kunafa, which is orange shredded pastry.

files.title: File:Halal Beef Lasagne and Cauliflowers - Foodilic 2024-08-12.jpg
files.reason: A canteen tray where the lasagne is a brown lump beside yellow cauliflower. Accurately titled, unappetising, and unrecognisable as the dish.

files.title: File:Levantine Lentil Soup winter Newton Massachusetts New England.jpg
files.reason: A featureless pale disc filling the frame. Nothing in it reads as soup.

files.title: File:Mushroom Risotto (4789415965).jpg
files.reason: A pan of raw mushrooms with cured meat through it. Not risotto, and the meat is not something this catalogue would serve.

files.title: File:Fried oysters with soft scrambled eggs don of Nakau.jpg
files.reason: Breaded fried oysters on rice. The title mentions scrambled eggs; the photograph is a seafood donburi.

files.title: File:Top view of cheese kunafa at Agasi, Lajpat Nagar, Delhi (2025-10-04).jpg
files.reason: A flat browned disc that reads as a potato rösti. The second candidate from the same category and the second one that is not kunafa; this recipe keeps the fallback.

files.title: File:E22011 at Ulukent.jpg
files.reason: A commuter train at Ulukent station. The first attempt was an aerial view of the town — the dish is named after the place, and its Commons category is transport and landscapes.

files.title: File:Mushroom risotto (3990739885).jpg
files.reason: Correctly a mushroom risotto, and there is a glass of red wine on the table beside it. Same disqualification as the burger.

files.title: File:Fried oysters with soft scrambled eggs bowl of Matsuya.jpg
files.reason: Fried oysters in egg on rice, again, from a different Japanese restaurant. The phrase 'soft scrambled eggs' appears on donburi menus and keeps winning the search.

files.title: File:Five Guys banana milkshake (40878734941).jpg
files.reason: A branded fast-food shake cup with the chain's logo across it. Someone else's trademark, and a takeaway cup is not a photograph of something you made.

files.title: File:Menemen Emiralem Strawberry.jpg
files.reason: A punnet of strawberries. Third attempt for this recipe and the third non-food result: the dish shares its name with a Turkish district, so its Commons category is landscapes, trains and produce. It keeps the branded fallback.

files.title: File:Asado Bogotano.jpg
files.reason: A Colombian charcoal barbecue: steak, blood sausage, plantain and potatoes, with corn cobs among them. The corn is real and the photograph is of a meat grill, not of grilled corn.

files.title: File:Gherkins and Onions.JPG
files.reason: Two jars of gherkins and pickled onions. Torshi lift is pink pickled turnip; nothing in the frame is a turnip and nothing is pink.

files.title: File:Basturma or Pastroma from Armenia 2.JPG
files.reason: An uncut block of cured basterma on a white background. The dish is eggs fried with basterma; this is the raw ingredient and there is no egg in it.

files.title: File:Chilli Garlic Chuntney and Namkeen Lassi.JPG
files.reason: A chapati with chilli chutney, garlic cloves and a glass of NAMKEEN — salted — lassi. Salted lassi is a different drink from mango lassi and there is no mango in the frame.

files.title: File:Batata bhaji and chai-Pune-Maharashtra.jpg
files.reason: A metal plate of batter-fried bhaji and green chillies, with a paper cup of chai beside it. The photograph is of the snack; the tea is an accessory in the corner.

files.title: File:Mmm... sliders and deep fried hash browns (7958927842).jpg
files.reason: Four cheeseburger sliders surrounding a pile of shredded hash browns. The hash browns are there, but a card for a potato recipe that shows four burgers promises the wrong meal.

files.title: File:And Then There Were Leftovers.jpg
files.reason: A kitchen counter of Thanksgiving leftovers: sliced turkey in the foreground, green beans, gravy, stuffing, and a small dish of mashed potato among them. The mash is a bit part.

files.title: File:Agua de Jamaica.jpg
files.reason: The hibiscus drink itself is right, and there is a dark long-necked bottle beside it that cannot be identified from the frame. In a catalogue built for Egypt an unidentifiable bottle that may be beer is not a risk worth taking; the same call was made on the burger and the mushroom risotto.

files.title: File:QAMAR AD-DIN.jpg
files.reason: A branded bottle of Kassatly Chtaura apricot syrup with the label filling the frame, beside a glass. Somebody else's trademark, and a bought concentrate rather than the drink made from the apricot sheet.

files.title: File:Cacio e pepe at trattoria in Rome.jpg
files.reason: The pasta is exactly right and there is a carafe and a stemmed glass of white wine on the table with it. Same disqualification as the mushroom risotto and the burger: this catalogue is built for Egypt.

files.title: File:Frijoles con queso,.jpg
files.reason: A blurred phone snapshot across a table: a bowl of beans with cheese being pulled out of it, several people's hands and bodies in frame. Too poor to use, and it photographs identifiable people rather than a dish.

files.title: File:Cafe Turque.jpg
files.reason: A plain white mug of black coffee on a garden table with two ring biscuits, heavily filtered. Turkish coffee is served in a small fincan with foam on top, usually beside its cezve; nothing here says which coffee this is.

files.title: File:Pasta with tomato sauce (6178622998).jpg
files.reason: Penne with AUBERGINE, basil and grated cheese, with grilled bread. A good pasta alla norma and not the Egyptian tomato-paste-and-garlic macaroni, which has none of those things.

files.title: File:Broiler-Bar.jpg
files.reason: A painted RESTAURANT SIGN reading BROILER-BAR, with a cartoon of two men over a grill. Not food at all. The strongest argument yet that a human has to look: it passed the licence, size, format, category and no-duplicate checks without difficulty.

files.title: File:Berenjenas con Miel.jpg
files.reason: Spanish berenjenas con miel — battered aubergine drizzled with honey. A real dish and a different one; the Egyptian version is fried plain and dressed with garlic and vinegar.

files.title: File:Samosas, snack food at Wikipedia's 16th Birthday celebration in Chittagong (01).jpg
files.reason: Fried samosas with a green potato-and-pea filling, photographed at an event. The shape is right and the filling visibly is not: this recipe is cheese sambousek.

files.title: File:GD 廣東 Guangdong 河源市 HeYuan 越王大道 YueWang Avenue Double Tree by Hilton Hotel Open Cafe n Restaurant 早餐 breakfast food buffet scrambled egg with tomato April 2026 N13P.jpg
files.reason: Two hotel buffet chafing pots on a service counter with their labels showing, one of them scrambled egg with tomato. A buffet line is not a plate of food.

files.title: File:Ελληνικό Σουβλάκι - panoramio.jpg
files.reason: Skewers on a charcoal grill whose meat is pale, marbled and pink — Greek souvlaki is traditionally PORK, and nothing in the frame rules it out. A catalogue built for Egypt does not gamble on that.

files.title: File:Bartley's.jpg
files.reason: A diner plate of corn dogs and sweet potato fries with a small ramekin of slaw at the edge, plus a cola. The slaw is a garnish in its own photograph.

files.title: File:AUD9 Buffet - Green Pepper (2110184894).jpg
files.reason: A restaurant buffet line of chafing dishes with a basket of naan in the foreground. Blurred, cluttered, and a photograph of a buffet rather than of bread.

files.title: File:Chicken katsu curry rice - Korpan.jpg
files.reason: A katsu cutlet sliced over rice and flooded with Japanese curry sauce. The recipe is the crumbed cutlet alone; the curry is most of the plate and most of the promise.

files.title: File:Syrian apricot paste 01.jpg
files.reason: Shrink-wrapped branded slabs of apricot paste on a market shelf with price tags. Packaging again, from a different angle — the second qamar el din candidate and the second that photographs the product rather than the drink.

files.title: File:Pickled food.JPG
files.reason: A dish of pickled cucumbers, green chillies, radish and a pickled lemon. Levantine mixed pickles; the dish is pink pickled TURNIP and there is no turnip in the frame.

files.title: File:Arabaga.jpg
files.reason: A branded tin of Arabağa Türk kahvesi standing on a counter. Somebody else's trademark, and a photograph of coffee grounds in a can rather than of coffee.

files.title: File:Refried Black Beans (4646266085).jpg
files.reason: A well-photographed mound of BLACK beans. The recipe is built on kidney beans and the colour is the one thing a user checks against the picture.

files.title: File:Roat - A Punjabi dish served with daliya(cracked wheat porridge).jpg
files.reason: A polystyrene bowl of Punjabi daliya with a piece of cake, photographed on an office desk beside a keyboard and a pair of glasses. The wheat porridge is close, the dish and the setting are not.

files.title: File:American Breakfast (28188218105).jpg
files.reason: A café breakfast table: a basket of croissants, a cappuccino, eggs on muffins and an omelette, with two hash brown triangles as a side on each plate.

files.title: File:Akha cuisine Mochue tong-uh.JPG
files.reason: An Akha herb potato mash, dim and heavily green. Recognisably mashed potato and recognisably a different dish from buttery mash.

files.title: File:Banarasi Lassi.jpg
files.reason: A clay cup of thick white Banarasi lassi topped with pistachio and saffron. A beautiful photograph of a lassi with no mango in it.

files.title: File:Kolkata Wayside Tea Stall.jpg
files.reason: A street vendor's hands pouring chai from a pan beside a grimy burner. It is chai, and it is a process photograph of a stall rather than a cup of tea.
